Title: Threshold Road Run 15, 15 Minutes
WorkoutDescription: Threshold pace = 10-15km race pace/max effort pace you could sustain for 60min (therefore NOT a sprint). It should be comfortably hard (7/10 RPE) Threshold runs are great to help you become more efficient at faster paces, increases your lactate clearance rate, improves your endurance, fitness and metabolic efficiency.

Title: Easy Effort Trail Run + 10 x 10 sec Strides (30 rest between)
WorkoutDescription: Easy effort runs are the bread and butter of your training. They are harder than recovery runs, but easier than threshold and are intended to boost your overall aerobic endurance by increasing the volume of your training safely. You should be able to do a hard session the next day, if not - you're running these too hard. Strides are shorts sprints at 90% effort, not flat out, to improve leg turnover. Run these on a flat surface, road or grass.

They are intended to enhance recovery, stimulate blood flow and prepare you for your next work out. Going too hard on these runs increases the risk of injury and means you will not be able to get the most out of your hard sessions to come. Keep the easy days easy so you can run the hard days hard.

Title: Easy Effort Trail Run + 10 x 10 sec Strides (30 rest between)
WorkoutDescription: Easy effort runs are the bread and butter of your training. They are harder than recovery runs, but easier than threshold and are intended to boost your overall aerobic endurance by increasing the volume of your training safely. You should be able to do a hard session the next day, if not - you're running these too hard. Strides are shorts sprints at 90% effort, not flat out, to improve leg turnover. Run these on a flat surface, road or grass.
